summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title) once per title control; CHANGELOG.md adds an Added heading above Fixed with one PR 2200 bullet; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Tests and mypy were not run, per instructions, so the work is verified by reading only. Nothing was committed.
